# 1.30.0 — a smoother window, a dependable updater, no lost messages

Settings, keys and conversations from earlier versions are read as they are.

## Smoother and faster

- **No white flash at startup.** Windows shows the window a moment before the program has drawn
  it, and until now that moment was a white rectangle — up to seconds under a debugger. Now it is
  filled with the background color of your theme, and the content appears on top of it.
- **The window is drawn sooner.** For the first frame only the chats that fit in the sidebar are
  laid out, and the rest of the list follows right after. With 300 chats in 15 folders, the time
  between the window appearing and being drawn went from about 470 ms to 175 ms on a cold start,
  and the whole start from 1.76 s to 1.47 s.
- **Resizing the window with a long chat no longer stalls.** While you drag the edge, maximize or
  restore the window, only the messages around what you see are laid out again; the rest follow
  in small steps right after, and the text you are reading stays where it is. With 1,200
  messages, one step of dragging the edge took about a second of work and now takes 18 ms;
  maximizing went from 1,078 ms to 31 ms and restoring from 1,156 ms to 31 ms. The first frame of
  a maximized window is drawn almost at once, so Windows has far less time to show a black area
  where the window grows.
- **Folders in the chat list open and close smoothly** — the rows grow out of the folder card
  and fade in, the chevron turns — and only the rows that changed are rebuilt. With 300 chats in
  15 folders a folder click went from 119 ms to 11 ms, and the list after renaming a chat from
  123 ms to 19 ms. The motion follows the "Animations" switch.
- **Dialogs over a long chat open without a hitch.** The question about a risky action, notices,
  the journal, PC health and the other panels used to make the window touch every element of the
  conversation twice — when opening and when closing. Now the chat is covered by a single layer.
  On a 1,200-message chat the journal opens in less time than we can measure (it took 43–78 ms)
  and PC health in 12–47 ms (it took 51–78 ms).
- **Popup shadows are no longer cut off.** Menus, dropdowns and pickers share one shadow with
  room around it, and every card opens exactly where it did before.
- Appearance sliders no longer write the settings file on every step of the drag.
- Saving a chat while it streams costs the window much less: the chat list index is written in
  the background.

## Updates

- **An update icon in the title bar** appears when there is something to say: a new version is
  available, downloading (with a progress ring), ready to install, installing, or failed. Click it
  for a compact panel with the same button as the update card in Settings, plus **Cancel
  download** and **Details**.
- **A background download can be cancelled** — from that panel or from the update card. The
  cancelled version is not downloaded again and not installed when you close the program until
  the next start; pressing Update brings it back. Before, the next check started the same
  download again and closing the program finished and installed it.
- **Update while a background download is running now joins it** instead of cancelling it: the
  card shows "Downloading version X — N %, then installing and restarting", and the program
  installs and restarts as soon as the file is in. Cancel is there for a download you asked for.
- A late answer from an earlier check or a cancelled download no longer overwrites what the card
  shows, and a failed download keeps saying so instead of switching back to "Update available".
- If version 1 is downloaded and version 2 is still downloading when you close the program, it
  waits for version 2 a little before installing version 1.
- Switching the update channel stops a download of the other channel.
- A download that stops receiving data is reported as stalled instead of hanging.
- After a successful install the program does not check or download again, even if the restart
  failed.

## Chats

- **Sending a message while three other chats are answering no longer loses it.** The text,
  attachments and quotes stay in the box with a note to wait for one of the answers.
- Opening a chat no longer waits for drafts to be written to disk.
- Search by text in all chats runs in the background: typing stays responsive in large
  histories, and the results no longer rebuild while another chat is answering.

## Balance

- **The price breakdown under a message is complete with OpenRouter models.** When the chat
  title, summary, router, guard, agent model choice or work report ran on an OpenRouter model,
  its line was missing from the breakdown — the money was in the spending chart, but not under the
  message, and the router's share was counted as the chat model's. OpenRouter reports the price in
  a different place than Venice, and now both are read the same way everywhere.
- The balance badge now also learns the balance from the answers of agents, chat titles, chat
  summaries and work reports — before, only the main chat answer updated it.
